items.title: Pete Levin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: And I actually brought Jeff Berlin in, the original bass player, into the studio.

ctx.x: A dollar, or two dollars if it gets widespread enough. It definitely has an impact. And I think people don’t realize that it’s the same concept of the way people copy software and pass it around. Computer software. It doesn’t seem like a big — if you bought it and then make a copy for a friend or something, it doesn’t really feel like stealing. The people that do it are not thieves, they’re nice people. It’s hard to see the impact that it’s having on a whole industry when you do it. I had some help doing it but I…
